name: Negative Threads
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch .

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as the spell web except the webs are infused with negative energy. Any creature that enters or begins their turn within the webs takes 2d4 negative energy damage. Additionally, the caster can move the webs up to 10 feet as a swift action.
